contentPattern.structure: tab label + rich content panel (headings, images, paragraphs, lists)

suitableFor: adventure/trip detail description bodies split into Overview / Itinerary / What to Bring tabs
long-form content organized into a small number of switchable, richly formatted panels
detail pages where sections of body copy (with images and lists) are grouped under labeled tabs
notSuitableFor: brief content that doesn't need switching (use default content)
content that must all be visible at once (use default content / columns)
